==Objectives==
* Obtain the {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}}.
* Expand your {{im/loz|Item|Bomb}} carrying capacity.
* Defeat {{im/loz|Boss|Digdogger}}.
* Obtain a {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}}.
* Obtain the fifth {{im/loz|Item|Piece of Triforce}}.

==Walkthrough==
=== Advised Preparation ===
*Use the ladder to collect the {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}} at '''D-2''' in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 2|section 2]].
*By now you should have twelve heart containers in total. Head to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|cemetery]], where at '''B-3''', the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Sword}} can be found.

=== Prerequisites ===
* {{im/loz|Item|Ladder}}.

=== Dungeon Walkthrough ===
#To enter this dungeon, you must discover the secret to climbing to the top of the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 3|Lost Hills]].
#From the entrance, go right and clear this room to obtain a {{im/loz|Item|Key}}. You may bomb the top wall to expose a passage to the man with information about this dungeon's boss's weakness: "''Digdogger hates certain kind of sound.''"
#Enter the room above the entrance and defeat the {{im/loz|Enemy|Gibdos}} for another {{im/loz|Item|Key}}. You may bomb the left wall to provide yourself with a shortcut to the left which bypasses the '''[[The Legend of Zelda/Bosses#Dodongos|Dodongos]]''' in the next step.
#If you enter the room above, you must face three {{im/loz|Boss|Dodongos}}. Defeat them in the usual manner, either feeding them two bombs, or stunning them by exploding a bomb in their face. If you unlock the north door, you can obtain the dungeon's {{im/loz|Item|Map}}.
#From the Dodongo room, enter the left room, and obtain a {{im/loz|Item|Key}}. Then enter the room below and defeat the {{im/loz|Enemy|Gibdos}}. To access the room to the left, you must bomb the left wall.
#Enter the left room and defeat all of the {{im/loz|Enemy|Blue Darknuts}}. When the room is clear, push the leftmost block aside and enter the stairwell. Take the passage, and you will arrive in the right top most room of the dungeon.
#From there, head left and defeat all of the {{im/loz|Enemy|Blue Darknuts}}. When the room is clear, push the single block to reveal a stairwell that leads to the {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}}. Collect it and return to the right.
#Now head to the room below, and collect a {{im/loz|Item|Key}}. Bomb the right wall to discover a passage to a room where a man will add four {{im/loz|Item|Bombs}} to your bomb storage capacity for 100 rupees.
#Return through the underground passage, and back to the room with three Dodongos.
#From the Dodongo room, head right, and then above to collect another {{im/loz|Item|Key}}. Head up again and defeat the {{im/loz|Boss|Red Darknuts}} to discover the {{im/loz|Item|Compass}}.
#From the compass room, head up and obtain a {{im/loz|Item|Key}}. Head left, and defeat the {{im/loz|Enemy|Gibdos}} to receive another {{im/loz|Item|Key}}.
#Head left once more and you'll encounter the {{im/loz|Enemy|Pols Voices}}. The top wall can be bombed to reveal a path to a man who is knowledgeable on the weakness of Pols Voice: "''Secret power is said to be in the arrow.''"
#If you head left, you will encounter the boss. There is a room below the boss room that contains nothing but {{im/loz|Enemy|Gibdos}}.

==Boss==
*The boss is {{im/loz|Boss|Digdogger}}. While large, Digdogger is invincible. You must collect the {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}} in this dungeon in order to defeat it. Blow the Whistle and it will shrink into a {{im/loz|Boss|Small Digdogger}}, which can be stabbed by your sword.
*Defeat it to earn a {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}}. Continue on to the room above to obtain the fifth {{im/loz|Item|Piece of Triforce}}.

==Resupply ==
Dungeon 5 is isolated, and as such, you may want to look at the supply points before heading to the dungeon.
* An old woman selling {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}} and a {{im/loz|Item|2nd Potion}} is 4 screens west and 1 screen south of the Lost Hills.
